Specification: This module is a small model-checking wrapper around another specification named spanning. It defines a single top-level operator, Neighbors, as a concrete set of two pairs, presumably to instantiate or constrain the underlying spanning-system model with a specific graph topology. The file contains no variables, no actions, no temporal specification, and no proofs; it is therefore a very small structural module rather than a full standalone behavior specification.
